content.rationale: S2-validate fixes that every load checks each document against the node schema the binary carries, embedded with `include_str!` — no schema read from the repository — and nothing unchecked surfaces to a verb; S2-invalid fixes the failure — invalid with the reason attached, so a missing file reads apart from a broken one; D1c fixes the document, D1d the schema. It reads through the read module (M-store-read, tmwyqnyz) at the change the id names (D1b) and locates through store_path, and carries its own failure reasons rather than the verb refusal value; absence at that change is its own Missing, apart from any read failure, and the read reaches the runner (M-jj, zruxtxrv). I1-serde (`orrvsxqq`) fixes the JSON layer the module is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive, and I1-schema (`zmmyomyp`) fixes the validator these documents are checked with.
